title: William and Sarah Grey of 2010 Prairie get faces from stand-in portraits
items: No photograph of either Grey survives, so their faces are now fitted to two sepia portraits chosen as stand-ins, point by point over about 400 face points each, and drawn at the age the pictures show. Each card shows the portrait beside the model and marks it as a stand-in, not them.

William is heavy-set and thick-necked, with long wavy hair swept back, a full beard and heavy moustache drawn hair by hair (curling, sandy red with grey through it), his lower lip and chin showing under the moustache and the beard's line running up his cheeks as in his picture, and a dark brown three-piece suit.

Sarah is full and sturdy, with high cheekbones, a fine nose and chin and thin lips, her greying light brown hair drawn up to a round knot high on her head, in a dark brown dress with a white lace collar.
